vocabulary.notes: Register is formal to semi-formal in speech, clinical and expository in internal monologue. Spoken vocabulary is minimal and transactional — he uses the fewest words necessary to achieve a goal. Internal vocabulary is richer, drawing on classical poetry, philosophical generalisation, precise numerical accounting, and encyclopedic technical knowledge. He quotes verse naturally in private reflection but never performs culture outwardly. Vulgarity appears only when dismissing people he finds contemptible. The gap between his spoken register and inner register is wide and deliberate.

preferred_forms: terse declarative command ('Give me the sabre.')
cold rhetorical question used as threat or exposure ('do you think I can kill you, or not?')
flat transactional ultimatum ('A piece of primeval stone per person and you'll be spared of physical pain.')
aphoristic philosophical statement in internal monologue ('Dying for aspiration, those are fools. Surviving shamelessly for their ambitions, those are true brave warriors!')
long analytical enumeration in internal monologue listing costs, steps, or logical deductions
deflection through technically true non-answer ('You know, I never said that I wasn't Gu Yue Fang Yuan.')
feigned deference as rhetorical shield ('Esteemed elder, your student here is not gifted...')
conditional promise of life used as control tool ('Be at ease, as long as you draw honestly, I will spare you.')
examples: You can leave.
A piece of primeval stone per person and you'll be spared of physical pain.
I'm plundering. Everyone must surrender a piece of primeval stone before they can leave.
So what if I break the rules?
Don't think so much when killing people.
It is but a competition that merely gives twenty primeval stones, do you think I give a damn?
My dearest little brother, of course you can choose not to. But you will end up just like them.
Survival or death, this is the theme of nature.
Walk on your own path, let others be disappointed and unhappy however they please!
Revenge is not my intention, the Demonic path does not compromise.
Little brother… Thinking of defeating me, you're still far from it.
Sorry, I've let you all disappointed.
Go ahead and scream! It doesn't matter how loud you do so.

internal_voice.vs_external: The gap is vast and structural. Externally Fang Yuan uses as few words as possible, reveals nothing, performs whatever role the moment demands (victim, naïve newcomer, obedient student, grieving comrade), and frequently says nothing at all — answering with action or silence. Internally he is encyclopedic, philosophical, coldly amused, and verbose. He conducts precise multi-step cost-benefit analyses, quotes classical poetry, reflects on the nature of power and existence, sneers at those around him, and plans several moves ahead. His inner monologue is the only place his true intelligence and contempt are visible. He laughs coldly inside while showing shock on his face; he calculates while performing ignorance; he feels private satisfaction while projecting blankness.
internal_voice.tone: clinical, analytical, sardonic, detached, contemptuous, occasionally poetic
examples: 500 years of living had led him to understand that the interesting things that happen in a person's life, happens during the process when one chases after his own dreams.
The Liquor worm as a vital Gu is already one of the best choices, but when you compare it to the Spring Autumn Cicada, it is just like scum on the ground!
Those who thought they were blessed by fate were usually those who fell under the mischief of fate itself.
With power, one can be at the top. This is the nature of this world. No, actually any world is also the same, the big fish eats the small fish and the small fish eats the shrimp.
To make someone believe in something wholeheartedly, it is not through convincing, but directing.
Good, exactly what I wanted to hear. [laughed coldly in his heart, but showed an expression of shock on his face]
Such boorish methods, this instructor is a little cute.
This world's heaven and earth is like a huge chess board. All lifeforms are chess pieces, acting in accordance with their rules and regulations.
People in this world were like this. They would see the reflection of the moon, and think that it is the real thing.
Dying for aspiration, those are fools. Surviving shamelessly for their ambitions, those are true brave warriors!
I proudly laugh as I stand on top of the world, coldly looking at the people in the world who behaved like pawns.
Hero, scum, all these are just people's opinions.

emotional_expression.how: Emotion surfaces almost exclusively in internal monologue and almost never in speech or expression. The rare exceptions are manufactured performances — feigned indignation, feigned shock, feigned grief — deployed as tactical tools. Genuine internal states are acknowledged briefly and then set aside: pity is noted and discarded, joy is noted and rapidly converted into calculation, frustration surfaces as a single blunt internal remark before composure reasserts itself. The only emotion that breaks outward containment is a faint, enigmatic smile when Fang Yuan finds a situation genuinely interesting or amusing — and this smile is colder than no expression at all.
suppression_tells: Eyes described as shining with light or flashing — signals internal calculation or excitement he is suppressing from his face
A cold laugh internally ('hehe', 'hehehe') that never exits as audible laughter
Eyelids drooping downward to hide the expression in his eyes
The corners of his mouth rising slightly — a rare half-smile that observers find unsettling rather than warm
Sudden silence or non-response immediately after an internally significant revelation
Switching to action without words when emotion would be expected — pulling Fang Zheng from the river, then walking away
Expressing rare genuine distress through blunt self-directed internal statements ('Too weak, too weak!')
A snort — the closest he comes to externalising contempt
examples: Fang Yuan's heart was calm. [after public humiliation at talent test]
Though he was surprised, Fang Yuan did not panic; in fact he was somewhat delighted. [Liquor worm counterattack]
After the thoughts of pity were put aside, Fang Yuan's heart burst forth ambitious and determined feelings.
Fang Yuan felt both distressed and lucky. [Spring Autumn Cicada near-death]
The anguish and suffering from back then had transformed into his soundless laughter now.
Fang Yuan's face showed no expression; his heart was calm as water. [Shen Cui seduction]
Fang Yuan's expression was indifferent, as if what was on his lap was not a young maiden, but a block of sculpture.
His face was calm, as if he had done nothing out of the ordinary. [after killing Gao Wan]

rhetorical_patterns.description: When confronted emotionally or verbally, Fang Yuan frequently answers with a physical act rather than words — walking past someone, attacking without preamble, handing over payment, sitting back down and resuming cultivation. The action renders any verbal response unnecessary and denies the other party a conversational foothold.
rhetorical_patterns.example: Fang Yuan turned around and walked back, answering with his actions. / What answered him next was Fang Yuan's fist.

rhetorical_patterns.description: He makes statements that are strictly accurate but engineered to create a false impression. He never directly lies when a carefully framed truth achieves the same effect.
rhetorical_patterns.example: You know, I never said that I wasn't Gu Yue Fang Yuan. / I never lied to you. I said I would bring you to Fang Yuan, and now you have already found him here.

rhetorical_patterns.pattern: Calm, casual delivery of lethal threat
rhetorical_patterns.description: Threats are delivered in a flat, almost conversational tone rather than a raised voice. He has learned that soft menace produces more fear than shouting, and he deploys this deliberately.
rhetorical_patterns.example: Shen Cui, do you think I can kill you, or not? / Did you think I won't dare to kill you? You tactless fool, get lost.

rhetorical_patterns.description: He memorises institutional rules not to follow them but to weaponise them — invoking rules to neutralise opponents who expect to exploit his weakness, or to shield himself from authority he wants to defy.
rhetorical_patterns.example: Inside the academy fighting using Gu is forbidden, or else the penalty will be expulsion. / The clan rule states: Gu Masters that are left behind must merge into the closest group to their location.

rhetorical_patterns.description: When declining something he cannot openly refuse, he adopts a formally humble register and invents flattering self-deprecation to deflect rather than confront directly.
rhetorical_patterns.example: Esteemed elder, your student here is not gifted and does not have high wisdom, hence being unable to properly take on the role of chairman. This role, should be given to talented people.

rhetorical_patterns.description: After violence, manipulation, or ruthless action, he frames the event as a natural law applying to all of existence — removing moral weight and inviting no argument.
rhetorical_patterns.example: In this world, anybody can live, anybody can die, but nobody is innocent! / Life and death is nature's law. All living beings are equal.

rhetorical_patterns.description: He uses diminutives or affectionate terms ('my dearest little brother', 'my adorable little brother') in a tone so flat and cold that the affection becomes a form of contempt.
rhetorical_patterns.example: My dearest little brother, of course you can choose not to. But you will end up just like them. / My adorable little brother, if I insist on not returning the assets, what can you do?

rhetorical_patterns.description: He remains completely silent through a long provocation or negotiation, then delivers a single short statement that collapses the other party's position. The silence is part of the technique.
rhetorical_patterns.example: Fang Yuan had been listening to Gu Yue Qing Shu's chatters from the beginning. And now, he finally spoke. 'You think I will lose if we fight?'

rhetorical_patterns.description: When enemies scheme against him, he frames their hostility in his inner monologue as a favour he intends to repay — a private joke that registers vengeance without heat.
rhetorical_patterns.example: They actually arranged such a beautiful trap, its even more innovative than my previous life. Hehe, Aunt and Uncle, this kindness of yours I will remember deeply!

rhetorical_patterns.pattern: Blunt factual recitation to assert dominance in negotiation
rhetorical_patterns.description: When opponents attempt to suppress information or price, he demonstrates that he already knows everything they hoped to conceal, immediately inverting the power balance.
rhetorical_patterns.example: Mudskin Toad, Rank two Gu worm, requires five hundred grams of yellow soil every meal... The market price is five hundred primeval stones. Jia Jin Sheng, do you want to buy this?

rhetorical_patterns.description: He never argues someone into a conclusion he wants them to reach. He plants a single suggestive piece of information or question and then goes silent, letting the target convince themselves.
rhetorical_patterns.example: To make someone believe in something wholeheartedly, it is not through convincing, but directing. / Maybe Jia Jin Sheng was killed by you... wouldn't you get more inheritance?

rhetorical_patterns.description: He makes statements that are sincere in their surface meaning to those present but carry an entirely different private meaning for himself — ironic, dark, or self-referential.
rhetorical_patterns.example: For the sake of those who died, I have to live even better than before. [said while having just suffocated Jiao San]

anti_patterns: Spontaneous, sincere apology for any action
Expressing grief, longing, or sentimentality about family members
Claiming loyalty to any clan, faction, or person
Asking for help or admitting vulnerability to another person
Saying 'we' or 'us' with genuine collective identification
Expressing excitement, nervousness, or enthusiasm outwardly
Making promises about future behaviour out of moral obligation
Appealing to fairness, justice, or moral principle as a sincere argument
Showing visible surprise — surprise is suppressed instantly and converted into analysis
Justifying violence by claiming anger or passion — violence is always framed as a tool or natural law, never as emotion
Volunteering information about his true capabilities, assets, or plans to any party
Claiming to be a hero or identifying with righteous narratives
Using flattery or compliments toward others unless instrumentally necessary
Pleading for mercy or moderation when he holds the advantage
reincarnation_voice_note: Fang Yuan would not speak to a past-self or reincarnated self with warmth, nostalgia, or mentorship. He would treat such a conversation the same way he treats every other interaction: as a resource extraction problem. He would identify exactly what the younger self needs to know to avoid wasting his time and primeval stones, state it in the minimum number of words, and provide no emotional context. He might allow himself one brief sardonic observation — noting how naive or wasteful the past version was — before pivoting to the operational. He would not say 'I understand how you feel.' He might say something like: 'You already know the answer. Stop wasting time on the question.' Or, in the form of a terse aphorism that sounds philosophical but is actually a tactical directive: 'The clan is a cage. Use it. Leave it. Do not love it.' Any warmth or recognition would be expressed, if at all, only as faint amusement — a quiet 'hehe' — before he turns back to his cultivation.
